pipeline.title: Situation
pipeline.detail: Ball-by-ball state: runs needed, balls left, wickets in hand, required vs current rate.

pipeline.title: Stakes
pipeline.detail: Match importance: playoff race, knockout, bilateral decider, tournament stage.

pipeline.title: Opponent threat
pipeline.detail: Quality of the bowler or batter faced, by tier and phase.

pipeline.title: Performance vs expected
pipeline.detail: Runs, wickets and WP added on each pressure ball, relative to the expected outcome.

pipeline.title: Shrink & rank
pipeline.detail: Empirical-Bayes shrinkage toward the role mean, bootstrap 1,000× for intervals.

limitations.title: Small samples at the death
limitations.detail: Specialist finishers face few pressure balls per season; intervals stay wide even after shrinkage.

limitations.title: No ball-tracking data
limitations.detail: Line and length come from commentary tags, which are inconsistent across broadcasters.

limitations.title: Fielding not modelled
limitations.detail: Dropped catches and misfields are credited to the bowler and batter, not the fielder.

limitations.title: Team context
limitations.detail: Batting depth changes how freely a batter can attack; this is only partly captured by wickets in hand.

limitations.title: T20I opposition strength
limitations.detail: Associate-nation fixtures are down-weighted, but the weighting itself is a modelling choice.
